move: selection frame draws, mockup drops in, cursor drags it to mobile width
how: A dotted canvas fades in, a blue SVG selection rect draws around the artboard with DrawSVG 0%→100% (power3.inOut, 1s), four corner handles pop with back.out(3) and two dimension labels fade in. The mockup (browser chrome plus a two-column hero) reveals with clip-path inset bottom 100%→0 (expo.inOut 0.9s), hero children rise and the stat card scales from 0.8 with back.out(1.6). At 34% an SVG cursor flies in from bottom-right, nudges onto the right handle, and from 42% a tweened object shrinks the artboard width 760→420 (expo.inOut 1.1s) via an onUpdate that sets style.width/left, the rect width and the label text, while the cursor moves with the handle; the grid collapses to one column (gridTemplateColumns tween), the stat card fades and the heading font-size tweens 42→34; the side label text swaps to 'Mobile / Home' via call(). From 60% the artboard sways rotationY 6 / rotationX -3 and back with sine.inOut, then at 92% lifts y -60 and fades, note and dots fade.
adapt: Replace the mockup contents (heading, body, buttons, stat card), the artboard name labels, the start/end widths and the accent blue; keep the 1s draw, the 1.1s expo.inOut resize and the cursor lead-in.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the artboard, frame SVG, cursor and note; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with draw at 0.01D, drop at 0.12D, cursor at 0.34D, resize at 0.42D, sway 0.6-0.9D, exit at 0.92D. The resize onUpdate must write to el-scoped nodes; from() tweens need immediateRender:false; gridTemplateColumns and fontSize tweens are layout tweens, not transforms.
caveats: side label text is changed by call() and never reset, so it reads 'Mobile / Home' on the second loop
render.json duration is 10s while the catalog lists 11s
resize tweens width/left/gridTemplateColumns/fontSize, forcing layout each frame
